mapper.select: SELECT cstmr_name ,cellphone ,cstmr_login_id FROM cstmr WHERE cstmr_name=#{cstmrName} and cellphone = #{cellphone}
SELECT cstmr_id ,cstmr_name ,cellphone ,cstmr_login_id ,cstmr_login_pw ,email FROM cstmr WHERE cstmr_name=#{cstmrName} and cellphone = #{cellphone} and cstmr_login_id = #{cstmrLoginId}

SELECT cstmr_id ,cstmr_cd ,cstmr_name ,telephone ,cellphone ,sex_cd ,birth_day ,birth_day_ty_cd ,zip_cd ,email ,addr ,bigo ,get_sms_yn ,get_email_yn ,facebook ,twitter ,instagram FROM cstmr WHERE cstmr_login_id=#{cstmrLoginId} and cstmr_login_pw=#{cstmrLoginPw}

SELECT C.cstmr_name ,C.birth_day ,C.birth_day_ty_cd ,C.cellphone ,C.addr ,C.cstmr_cd ,C.email ,C.facebook ,C.twitter ,C.instagram ,V.gsph_left ,V.gsph_right ,V.datetime ,(select count(coupon_id) from coupon where cstmr_id=#{cstmrId})coupon ,(select count(cstmr_id) from sale where cstmr_id=#{cstmrId} AND (result = '0000' or result='sucess' or result='0'))buyCount ,(select shop_name from shop where shop_id=V.visit_shop_id)shopName ,(select staff_name from staff where staff_id=V.staff_id) staffName FROM cstmr C LEFT JOIN visit_history V ON C.cstmr_id = V.cstmr_id WHERE C.cstmr_id = #{cstmrId} ORDER BY V.datetime DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT datetime, gsph_right, gsph_left, gcyl_right, gcyl_left, gaxis_right, gaxis_left, add_right, add_left, npc_right, npc_left, npa_right, npa_left, pd_right, pd_left, lsph_right, lsph_left, lcyl_right, lcyl_left, laxis_right, laxis_left, prism_right, prism_left, base_right, base_left, bc_right, bc_left, dia_right, dia_left, dom_eye FROM visit_history WHERE cstmr_id = ${cstmrId} ORDER BY datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT datetime ,(select shop_name from shop where shop_id = S.shop_id) shopName ,(select sum(prc) from salePrdct where sale_id = S.sale_id) ognPrice ,(select prdct_name from prdct, salePrdct P where prdct.prdct_id=P.prdct_id AND prdct.prdct_ty_cd='00300001' AND P.sale_id = S.sale_id) frame ,(select prdct_name from prdct, salePrdct P where prdct.prdct_id=P.prdct_id AND prdct.prdct_ty_cd='00300002' AND P.sale_id = S.sale_id) lens FROM sale S WHERE cstmr_id = #{cstmrId} and (result = '0000' or result='sucess' or result='0')
ORDER BY datetime DESC;
SELECT coupon_name, coupon_cd, start_date, end_date, dscnt_prcnt, dscnt_prc FROM coupon WHERE cstmr_id = #{cstmrId}

SELECT distinct(C.cstmr_id) , C.cstmr_name , C.cellphone , C.get_sms_yn ,max(S.datetime) as datetime FROM cstmr C INNER JOIN sale_off S ON C.cstmr_id = S.cstmr_id WHERE S.datetime >= #{sdate} and cellphone REGEXP '[0-9]{3}\-[0-9]{3,4}\-[0-9]{4}' and C.birth_day REGEXP '[0-9]{4}\.[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{2}' and 2020-substr(C.birth_day,1,4) < 19 GROUP BY C.cstmr_id HAVING datetime >= #{sdate} and datetime <= #{edate} ORDER BY datetime asc,C.cstmr_name asc

SELECT distinct(C.cstmr_id) , C.cstmr_name , C.cellphone , C.get_sms_yn ,max(S.datetime) as datetime FROM cstmr C INNER JOIN sale_off S ON C.cstmr_id = S.cstmr_id WHERE S.datetime >= #{startDate} and cellphone REGEXP '[0-9]{3}\-[0-9]{3,4}\-[0-9]{4}' and C.birth_day REGEXP '[0-9]{4}\.[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{2}' and 2020-substr(C.birth_day,1,4) >= 19 GROUP BY C.cstmr_id HAVING datetime >= #{startDate} and datetime <= #{endDate} ORDER BY datetime asc,C.cstmr_name asc

SELECT cstmr_id ,C.cstmr_cd ,C.cstmr_name ,(SELECT IFNULL(C.point,0)) + SUM(IF((H.point_status='P' and H.fmly_cd=C.cstmr_cd),H.point,0)) - SUM(IF((H.point_status='M' and H.fmly_cd=C.cstmr_cd),H.point,0)) as point_total ,C.telephone ,C.cellphone ,C.addr ,C.birth_day ,C.fmly_cd ,(select cstmr_name from cstmr where cstmr_cd = C.fmly_cd) as fmly_name ,(select telephone from cstmr where cstmr_cd = C.fmly_cd) as fmly_tel ,(select cellphone from cstmr where cstmr_cd = C.fmly_cd) as fmly_cell ,(select addr from cstmr where cstmr_cd = C.fmly_cd) as fmly_addr ,(select birth_day from cstmr where cstmr_cd = C.fmly_cd) as fmly_birth ,(SELECT IFNULL((select point from cstmr where cstmr_cd = C.fmly_cd),0))+SUM(IF((H.point_status='P' and H.fmly_cd=C.fmly_cd),H.point,0)) -SUM(IF((H.point_status='M' and H.fmly_cd=C.fmly_cd),H.point,0)) as fmly_total FROM cstmr C LEFT JOIN point_hist H ON H.fmly_cd = C.fmly_cd OR H.fmly_cd = C.cstmr_cd WHERE C.cstmr_name = #{cstmrName} AND (right(C.cellphone,4) = #{digit4} OR right(C.telephone,4) = #{digit4}) group by C.cstmr_cd order by C.cstmr_cd;
SELECT count(*) FROM cstmr C WHERE C.cstmr_name = #{cstmrName} AND (right(C.cellphone,4) = #{digit4} OR right(C.telephone,4) = #{digit4})

SELECT D.cstmr_id ,D.cstmr_name ,D.telephone ,D.cellphone ,D.addr ,D.birth_day ,D.cstmr_cd ,if( (D.fmly_cd is null) , D.cstmr_cd, D.fmly_cd) as fmly_cd ,D.email FROM cstmr C INNER JOIN cstmr D ON C.cstmr_cd = D.cstmr_cd or C.cstmr_cd = D.fmly_cd or C.fmly_cd = D.fmly_cd or C.fmly_cd = D.fmly_cd
WHERE C.cstmr_name = #{cstmrName} AND (right(C.cellphone,4) = #{digit4} OR right(C.telephone,4) = #{digit4});

select (select cstmr_cd from cstmr where cstmr_id = F.cstmr_id) as cstmrCd ,(select cstmr_name from cstmr where cstmr_id = F.cstmr_id) as cstmrName ,(select telephone from cstmr where cstmr_id = F.cstmr_id) as telephone ,(select cellphone from cstmr where cstmr_id = F.cstmr_id) as cellphone ,(select email from cstmr where cstmr_id = F.cstmr_id) as email ,(select addr from cstmr where cstmr_id = F.cstmr_id) as addr ,(select get_sms_yn from cstmr where cstmr_id = F.cstmr_id) as getSmsYn ,(select get_email_yn from cstmr where cstmr_id = F.cstmr_id) as getEmailYn ,(select get_dm_yn from cstmr where cstmr_id = F.cstmr_id) as getDmYn ,F.datetime as datetime FROM sale_off F where F.datetime >= #{sdate} and F.datetime <= #{edate} and (shop_id=#{shopId} or shop_id=#{shopNum}) group by cstmr_id order by cstmrName asc ;
